name: Doc Generation Modules
audience_feeling: I can find the feature, read the glossary, and open the right files without hunting chat history.
promise: Pin an optional doc register submodule: citations on the hub page, glossary then files on each feature page.

preferred_terms.DGM: this repository as the doc register / explore hub
preferred_terms.DCM: alternate short name for Doc Generation Modules
preferred_terms.register: the global citation index on explore/index.html
preferred_terms.feature page: one HTML page with glossary then associated files

avoid: claiming explore UI works without jev-ultrafast gating
direct pushes of product work to main
good_examples: Open the register, follow a citation into the feature glossary, then skim the file list.
bad_examples: Ship a React SPA and say the FE is done because it rendered once locally.
